name: Mesegar de Corneja (Spain)
description: Tierced at the hoist, blue with a white monogram of Mary between two yellow crowns, the fly red with a yellow sheaf of wheat between two white episcopal croziers.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 26 January 2011 (Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Ávila no. 56 of 22 March 2011); the flag is of 2:3, tierced at the hoist, the red fly bearing a yellow sheaf of wheat accompanied by two white episcopal croziers.

features.role: monogram of Mary between two yellow crowns
